projection.reason: one shared metric coordinate system is required so overlapping seed footprints share the same integer 100-m grid_row/grid_col and the frozen Moore-neighbour graph remains coherent across seed overlaps

seed_footprint.inclusion: 100-m cell center is within <=5000 m Euclidean distance of at least one seed center after projection

separation.reason: the source-indeterminate lane must remain independently retained and cannot be eliminated by source-ready evidence

forbidden: do not create a separate local grid origin per seed
do not use latitude-degree approximations for 100-m adjacency
do not merge source-ready and source-indeterminate lanes
do not interpret fine-frame cells as presence, suitability or exact survey sites
do not change 100-m spacing after seeing candidate counts or field outcomes
next_gate: After seed hashes are frozen, materialize the exact unioned 100-m fine frames under this projection and freeze cell counts/hashes before attaching fine public ecological sources.
